ATL.note: Young core led by Jalen Johnson after Trae Young trade. Tight cap, near 1st apron; Kispert a bad contract.

BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Over tax, under 1st apron. Jaylen Brown traded for Paul George.

BKN.note: Significant cap space and flexibility. Michael Porter Jr. extension-eligible. Aiming for playoff contention.

CHA.note: Young core after LaMelo Ball trade. Over cap, under tax. Grant Williams is a key trade chip.

CHI.note: Young core with Josh Giddey, Caleb Wilson. Under cap/tax. Some flexibility for trades.

CLE.note: Win-now core of Mitchell, Mobley, Harden, Allen. Over cap, under tax. Max Strus movable.

DET.note: Young core led by Cade Cunningham. Significant cap space and flexibility. Aiming to add talent.

IND.note: Haliburton returns healthy. Over tax, near 1st apron. Limited flexibility for major moves.

MIA.note: Giannis Antetokounmpo acquired. High payroll, aiming for championship. Limited cap flexibility.

MIL.note: Rebuilding after Giannis trade. Hard-capped at 1st apron. Herro, Kuzma are key trade chips.

NYK.note: Championship contender. Over 1st apron, limiting flexibility. Brunson's contract is team-friendly.

ORL.note: Young core of Banchero, Wagner. Over 1st apron, limiting flexibility. High internal growth potential.

PHI.note: Championship contender with Embiid, Brown, Maxey, LeBron. Embiid's health a factor.

TOR.note: Kawhi Leonard acquired. High payroll, over tax/near 1st apron. RJ Barrett is a key trade chip.

WAS.note: New core of Young, Davis, #1 pick Dybantsa. Hard-capped at 1st apron. High upside.

DAL.note: Young core with Cooper Flagg. Hard-capped at 1st apron. Flexibility for trades to acquire assets.

DEN.note: Championship core of Jokic, Murray. Over 2nd apron. Likely to trade Nnaji.

GSW.note: Aging core of Curry, Butler, Green. Over 1st apron, limiting flexibility. Upside relies on star health.

HOU.note: Talented core with Durant, Sengun. Over cap, under tax. Clint Capela is a bad contract.

LAC.note: New era after Kawhi trade. Good cap space, under tax. Young core with Garland, Ingram.

LAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Hard-capped at 1st apron, limited flexibility. Doncic's health is key.

MEM.note: Young core with cap space and large trade exception. Jerami Grant movable. High flexibility.

MIN.note: Talented core with Edwards, Ball. Over 1st apron, limited flexibility. DiVincenzo injured.

NOP.note: Talented core with Zion Williamson. Under tax/aprons. Could explore trading young players.

OKC.note: Young, talented core with SGA, Holmgren, Jalen Williams. Over 1st apron, under 2nd.

PHX.note: Hard-capped at 2nd apron. Core of Booker, Green, Bridges. Severely limited flexibility.

POR.note: Talented core with Morant, Holiday, Sharpe, Henderson. Under tax/aprons. Jerami Grant trade chip.

SAC.note: Core of Sabonis, LaVine. Over tax, near 1st apron. Limited flexibility, Sabonis a trade candidate.

SAS.note: Deep young core with Wembanyama, Fox. Good cap flexibility. High upside.

UTA.note: Young core with Jackson Jr., Markkanen. Good cap flexibility. Potential for future aggressive moves.
